jess: Quick design check — pushed an updated playground build to staging. Need quick eyes on streaming affordances + stop/regenerate placement + compact token counter + prompt library access. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd/playground-streaming (see frames ‘stream-compact’ & ‘prompt-drawer’). maria: Nice start. First impressions: the stream pulse is a bit loud, would prefer a small subtle pulse or thin gradient. :eyes: jess: Agreed. Thinking small dot + subtle shimmer instead of full gradient. Also debating putting Stop inline on each streaming response vs global toolbar. Thoughts? dan: Inline Stop seems more discoverable for a single message, global Stop better for overall session. Maybe both? inline primary, global as fallback. :thinking_face: alex: Inline primary makes sense for quick action. If we do inline, keep button small and icon-only. Use `aria-label="Stop generation"` and ensure focus ring shows. maria: UX nit: using icon-only loses affordance for screen readers — we should have visible text on hover or allow a long-press reveal. For small screens icon-only is fine. jess: +1. Proposal: icon-only inline for width-constrained views, text label on wider viewports. Global toolbar shows full label `Stop / Regenerate`. sam: Token counter: do we show tokens per message or session total? Session total gets noisy. Suggest collapsed badge per message that expands to details on click. maria: Collapsed badge is my vote. Location: bottom-right of message bubble, 10px from edge. Default shows token delta (e.g. `+123`). On hover reveal full counts and cost estimate. dan: Copy for tooltip: "Tokens: 123 (est. $0.00) — click for breakdown". Keep copy short. alex: Accessibility: ensure token info is keyboard reachable and uses `role="dialog"` when expanded. Keyboard users need a clear escape to close. Example snippet:```html
...
``` maria: Good. Also add `aria-live="polite"` for streaming status so screen readers hear that generation is ongoing. jess: Prompt library flow: slide-over from right vs modal. Preference? Slide-over keeps context, modal interrupts. dan: Slide-over + pin to keep open makes sense. Also add a mini-toolbar to drag prompts into the chat composer. Drag/drop works but also keyboard 'insert' action. maria: Design note: show recently used prompts at top, then folders. Provide small previews (1-2 lines). For a11y make sure previews have high contrast and a focus state. alex: Keyboard nav for prompt drawer: `Tab` to move items, `Enter` to insert, `Shift+Enter` to preview. Add `aria-describedby` for each prompt to include category. jess: Minor copy tweak: change primary button label from `Regenerate` to `Generate Again` in the inline context — it's clearer for new users. Thoughts? dan: I like `Generate Again` for inline. Keep `Regenerate` in advanced menus to reduce churn. maria: A11y checklist before shipping: 1) stop button has accessible name; 2) streaming status uses `aria-live`; 3) token counter keyboard + screen reader accessible; 4) prompt drawer focus trap + escape. alex: I'll mock the keyboard flow and share a quick prototype by EOD. @maria can you add the subtle pulse variant in figma? maria: On it. I'll export an alternate with reduced contrast pulse and the collapsed token badge states. ui-bot: playground-staging: v2.3.5 deployed to staging at 2026-03-22T14:22:10Z — tests: smoke ✅, a11y basic ✅ sam: I'll run a quick keyboard/a11y pass on staging after alex's prototype. jess: Awesome — thanks everyone. If no major objections I'll merge the variant into the next canary. :thumbsup: dan: No objections from me. maria: All good from design side. alex: Prototype incoming in ~3 hours. sam: reporting back once done. jess: Perfect — tagging this for the QA sprint.
